overview: The Medford School Committee approved a request for a district-wide field trip medical policy, voted to increase student meal prices for fiscal year 2018, and formally merged Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School under a single state LEA code. The committee also accepted routine financial, kindergarten registration, and state budget challenge reports while recognizing fundraiser distributions from the Jingle Bell Road Race.

items.title: District Field Trip Medical Policy
items.summary: Approved a motion directing the superintendent to draft a district-wide policy and protocol for nursing and medication administration during out-of-state and overnight field trips.

items.title: Jingle Bell Road Race Distribution
items.summary: Organizers presented $32,229 in raised proceeds distributed directly to participating school clubs, teams, and elementary schools.

items.title: FY 2017 Financial Report
items.summary: Accepted and placed on file the general financial report detailing general fund expenditures, extraordinary high school plumbing repairs, utility costs, and special education transportation.

items.title: FY 2018 School Meal Price Adjustments
items.summary: Approved a 25-to-40-cent rate increase for student breakfasts and lunches beginning in fiscal year 2018 to meet federal compliance guidelines and rising operational expenses.

items.title: Science Department Disney World Trip
items.summary: Approved an enrichment field trip to Walt Disney World in Florida for high school science students scheduled for February 2018.

items.title: Building Bridges to Kindergarten Report
items.summary: Received an informational update on registration procedures, parent information nights, and expanded evening hours for incoming kindergarten families starting in March 2017.

items.title: High School LEA Code Merger
items.summary: Formally approved combining Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School under a single state Local Education Agency code.

items.title: State FY 2018 Budget Challenges Report
items.summary: Received a preliminary forecast outlining state revenue projections, Chapter 70 aid, and legislative uncertainties affecting the district's upcoming FY 2018 budget.

items.title: Resolutions and Announcements
items.summary: Adopted resolutions offering birthday congratulations to a former headmaster and condolences to several local families, while issuing a proclamation observing Public Schools Week.
